Lottie guard rail

An autoplaying, looping lottie-player whose first frame is blank. It finishes loading later on one side than the other, so a run that let it play, or stopped it on frame 0, would compare different or empty frames.

Notes

Lottie animations are driven by script, not CSS, so the stylesheet that stills CSS animation cannot reach them. Holding every player on one frame once it loads is what makes the two sides comparable.
